summary: Jackson County, OR lookout built 1934, replaced by a 53-foot tower in 1963 that moved to Robinson Butte in 1973 or 1974; no source describes the old site today.

facts.design: Pole tower with L-4 cab; sources give 35, 40 or 45 feet for the 1934 tower
facts.status_note: Torn down in 1962; the 1963 replacement was moved to Robinson Butte; the Oregon list marks the site Tower Gone

staffing.status: staffed seasonally; last staffing mention in our sources is 1952

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Rogue River National Forest

events.note: District fire plan hopes to station a lookout man with telephone connections at Blue Rock
Register and firelookout.com give 1934; Oregon page says about 1935
Smoker-caused fire in Blue Canyon near Horseshoe Lake spotted and put out by the lookout
Site served as an AWS station from August 1942 to June 1943
Newspaper item (July 14, 1952) refers to the Blue Rock lookout station as a workplace
Old tower torn down to make room for a new tower
53-foot treated timber tower with flat R-6 cab built
Moved to Robinson Butte per register and firelookout.com; 1974 per the Oregon page and the Robinson Butte page

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and firelookout.com give 45 ft for the 1934 tower. The Oregon page's c.1935 entry gives 35 ft and a 1936 newspaper gives 40 ft. The brief's 10.7 m (35 ft) follows only the Oregon page, so height_m is left out of facts until resolved.
1934 in the register and on firelookout.com. The Oregon page says about 1935.
The tower moved to Robinson Butte in 1973 per the register and firelookout.com, and in 1974 per the Oregon page and the firelookout.com Robinson Butte page.

notes_for_editor: Original site: no source describes it today. Move of the 1963 tower to Robinson Butte is well sourced, but the Oregon list's standing tower at Robinson Butte was not checked on the ground to confirm it is the same structure. Build year and height conflict; height_m left out. Staffing evidence is thin (1940-1952 newspaper items via the Oregon page). Photos on the sources were not added (licence not stated).
